_meta.purpose: Cifra multi-instrumento de Marker In The Sand (Pearl Jam, Pearl Jam 2006).

title: Marker In The Sand
content:
{section: Intro}
( [C5]   [G5] [Bb5] [F5]   [C5]   [G5] [Bb5]  [F5] ) x2

{section: Verso 1}
            [C5]      [G5] [Bb5] [F5]
There is a Marker,
        [C5]       [G5]  [Bb5] [F5]
No one sees it cause of sand
                 [C5]    [G5] [Bb5] [F5]
That has covered over
         [C5]   [G5] [Bb5] [F5]
All the messages it kept
               [C5]      [G5] [Bb5] [F5]
From misunderstanding,
       [C5]   [G5]  [Bb5]  [F5]
What Original Truth was
            [C5]    [G5] [Bb5] [F5]
And now expanding
      [C5]         [G5] [Bb5] [F5]       [Bb]   [F]
In a faith, but not in love...

{section: Refrão 1}
[Bb]
What went wrong?
                  [Eb]
Walking tightrope high
             [Bb]
Over moral ground.
               [Eb]
Seeing visions of
                [F]
Falling up somehow.
            [Bb]
Oh do come down
                 [Eb]
With the living, let
                [Bb]
What is living love.
                 [Eb]
So unforgiving, yet
                     [F]
Needing forgiveness first...
                [C5]  [G5] [Bb5] [F5]
God, what do you say?

[C5]  [G5] [Bb5]

{section: Verso 2}
  [F5]       [C5]   [G5] [Bb5] [F5]
Those undecided
           [C5]        [G5] [Bb5] [F5]
Needn't have faith to be free.
              [C5]    [G5] [Bb5] [F5]
And those misguided,
             [C5]         [G5] [Bb5] [F5]
There was a plan for them to be...
                  [C5]  [G5] [Bb5] [F5]
Now you got both sides
           [C5]         [G5] [Bb5] [F5]
Claiming 'killing in god's name'.
            [C5]    [G5] [Bb5] [F5]
But god is nowhere
         [C5]     [G5] [Bb5] [F5]      [Bb] [F]
To be found, conveniently...

{section: Refrão 2}
          [Bb]
What goes on?
                   [Eb]
Walking tightrope high
             [Bb]

                 [Eb]

-fore you burn them down!
         [Bb]
Do come round
                 [Eb]
With the living, let
                [Bb]
What is living love.
              [Eb]
Unforgiving, yet
                     [F]
Needing forgiveness first...

God, what do you say?
                [C5]   [G5] [Bb5] [F5]
God, what do you say?

           [C5]     [G5] [Bb5] [F5]
I feel a sickness...
            [C5]    [G5] [Bb5] [F5]
A sickness coming over me
                [C5]   [G5] [Bb5] [F5]
Like watching freedom
               [C5]      [G5] [Bb5] [F5]

             [C5]  [G5] [Bb5] [F5]
